title: Unbounded Topology of Nodal Sets of Harmonic Functions
summary: For every integer \(n\ge 3\), every \(1\le \ell\le n-2\), and every sufficiently large integer \(m\), we construct harmonic functions \(u_{m,\ell}\) on the unit ball \(B_1(0)\subset\mathbb{R}^n\) such that the frequency is bounded independently of \(m\), every point of the nodal set \(\{u_{m,\ell}=0\}\cap B_{1/2}(0)\) is regular, but the Betti numbers satisfy \begin{align*} b_\ell\bigl(\{u_{m,\ell}=0\}\cap B_{1/2}(0)\bigr)\ge 2m. \end{align*} Thus bounded frequency, even together with regularity of the nodal set, does not imply a uniform topological bound.
